entities.title: A high-score table checked by replay
entities.summary: Lundey keeps only a best score on each device. Its engine gives the same game from the same seed and controls, so a shared table checked by replay could be added, as Hivestorm has.
entities.details: What it would take: the Worker issues a game's seed instead of the page drawing one from Math.random; the page records each step's Input; the Worker replays a submitted game with src/engine and keeps only the score the replay gives; and somewhere to keep the table, which the Worker does not have today (no database, no Durable Object). From then on the engine's behaviour is a promise: a change to rules.ts, maze.ts, game.ts or rng.ts changes what a recording replays to.
acceptanceCriteria: A game that may enter the table starts from a seed the Worker issued
The Worker replays a submitted game with src/engine and lists only the score the replay gives
Invited players can see the table

origin.description: Proposed while writing the game: the engine was written to replay exactly, and the first version uses that only in its tests. The owner has not asked for it.

sources.symbol: the same seed and the same controls give the same game
